USE WAREHOUSE team_f_wh;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_f_db.development.question_pool (
  QUESTION_ID      NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  QUESTION_TYPE    VARCHAR(50),
  QUESTION_TEXT    VARCHAR(500),
  ANSWER_PCT       NUMBER(5,2),
  DENOMINATOR_CNT  NUMBER,
  NUMERATOR_CNT    NUMBER
)
